text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa...!! Haa, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (—Always.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(It feels as though I'm sinking deep 
below.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The sound of footsteps, the cheers, the 
howling wind. Breathing, heartbeat, the 
creaking of my body—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Everything grows distant. As distant as 
if I were looking up from the bottom of 
the water.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(A heaviness clings to my body. I can 
barely tell whether I'm inhaling or 
exhaling, the boundary between the two has 
grown so blurred.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...—Even so, I will run.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Don't lose focus. Don't lose form. Don't 
slow down. Keep this pace, maintain this 
speed.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(With the form I've chosen, polished, and 
perfected. I will—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (I will see my job through to the end!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――In 1st place is Believe!! It's Believe!! 
Living up to the name "Belief", that 
flaw-free, perfected running style is pure 
craftsmanship!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling her one-of-a-kind role, she has 
claimed the throne as the fastest queen of 
autumn!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... haah――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fuji, Fuji!! Did you see the Sprinters 
Stakes— Ah! I knew you'd be watching!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course! ...Believe pulled it off 
magnificently.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it! We pulled it off! We broke 
through! Into a brand-new realm—!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey Fuji. You know, when I watched her 
run, I felt something in her that was a 
bit like me, and you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. I get it. I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But— Believe set out toward a 
completely different horizon! Toward the 
1,200m world of sprints!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean, does that mean— Ehehe, I 
wonder what it is~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I wonder what? Aha—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's so exciting, isn't it?! Absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And in the underground paddock path 
right after the race. Holding back the 
urge to dash out, I wait for Believe's 
return."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My mind was thrown into utter chaos. How 
should I comfort her? How should I praise 
her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To her, who quietly endured even the days 
of hardship and finally grasped the 
ultimate result. What words could I 
possibly say to her—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah...... I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I won. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ? Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I understand. For the most part... 
probably.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's completely written all over your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "That's why I understand. ...I know."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I know, so...—yeah.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Believe brilliantly claimed the 
title of Autumn Sprint Queen, just as she 
had set out to do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the following day. Believe was finally 
given a proper day off, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.
choice_data_list: Huh! Isn't today your day off?
Huh! Isn't today your day off?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes, I know. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I brought it. Here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe hands me the contents of the bag. 
It looks like a bottle filled with an 
amber liquid that gives off a rich, mellow 
aroma, but—
choice_data_list: This scent... Could it be plum blossoms?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's plum syrup made by steeping 
plums in rock sugar. If you mix it with 
water or sparkling water, it makes plum 
juice. Kiyomi-san shared some with me.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that place we often go to on our 
runs...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Plum blossom season is a bit past its 
peak, so I was worried whether any would 
be left."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you could share some with me. 
...I'll be sure to thank you properly next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Believe looking relieved, I gaze at 
the contents of the jar with a curious 
sensation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, why did Believe go off 
in search of plum syrup that was somewhat 
out of season? While I tilted my head in 
confusion—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we propose a toast?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It was always like that... whenever 
Grandpa finished work."

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
"Come over here too, Believe. Have some of 
this delicious, delicious plum juice."

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"...Hm. Come on, get over here. Is this... 
enough ice?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: A drink after work is always...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A toast with the plum wine Grandma brewed 
and some plum juice... Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, this isn't the 'end.' Our next 
job begins right away."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However, just a little bit. ...Just for 
today. Would you like to share a toast?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her quiet voice resonates in my chest. The 
slight tremor in it seeps deep into my 
heart.
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...I'd really love to make a toast.

Yeah. ...I'd love to make a toast with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. ...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tinking their glasses of shimmering amber 
liquid together, they both take a sip.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The slightly rich plum juice slid down my 
throat, leaving behind a refreshing 
aftertaste that lingered on and on.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah!! ...Believe-chan~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hello... Oh, or maybe almost good evening? 
Hehe. Are you on your way home?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Is Dantsu-san... still in the middle 
of training?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was just about to go run the 
perimeter!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Believe-chan, I was watching. 
Congrats on 1st place in the Sprinters 
Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You really saw it through to the end, 
didn't you? Truly, truly... you're 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Still, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I'm trying my hardest too, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-chan, you know... After the 
Kikuka Sho, I'm going to run in the Mile 
Championship."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So right now, I'm doing my best. ...I'm 
really trying!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because in a Mile GⅠ—on the ultimate 
stage— I want to make absolutely sure I 
take the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...You see, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I always wondered if it was just running 
away. Changing my race distance, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Are you gonna quit just because it didn't 
go well?” “Are you running away just 
because things didn't go your way?” “Are 
you really okay with that?” ...and stuff 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: But you know, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —No, definitely not!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's not running away. Nor is it 
hesitation! I—definitely want to be the 
star!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To stay true to that dream... to that 
conviction, I'm heading out onto the stage 
meant just for me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Believe-chan. If you'd like to— No, 
wait! You definitely have to watch!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to watch me. See how strong... 
and fast I've become, thanks to you."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(After a moment, Dantsu gave a shy smile 
and ran off.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (I am—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...There was a slight, ticklish feeling 
in my chest. And for some reason, I just 
stood there frozen—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah. Yeah, thank you, Grandpa.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think... I did a good job. 
............Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Next? Next... I'm aiming for the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. It's a spring 1200m 
GⅠ, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Okay. Got it, I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. ...Because Trainer is here with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I'm okay. Yeah. ...See you later, 
Grandpa."
